chunks: And from him, from Fadalah, from Mu'awiya ibn 'Ammar, who said: Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him) said:
The prayer of the eclipse: if you finish before it clears, then repeat it.

key_terms.تَنْجَلِيَ: It clears (referring to the eclipse ending)
key_terms.صَلَاةُ الْكُسُوفِ: Prayer of the eclipse (solar or lunar)

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling on repeating the eclipse prayer if finished before the eclipse ends?
ai.summary: Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) establishes that the eclipse prayer (Salat al-Kusuf) is not considered complete until the celestial phenomenon has fully subsided; thus, if the sun or moon is still partially obscured when the prayer concludes, it must be repeated. This ruling underscores the Shia jurisprudential view that the efficacy of this specific supererogatory prayer is intrinsically linked to the duration of the eclipse itself, distinguishing it from general voluntary prayers.
